SamH: FYI planning a small night canary for qkernel-v4.2-quant at 01:00 UTC. Matmul+quant kernel heuristic + thermal shim. Request 10% canary for 20m.
MayaL: ack. which slice?
SamH: start with eu-west-1-night. ops, please be on standby.
DiegoR: rollback criteria?
SamH: Abort if p99 >12% increase OR any top10-eval mismatch >0.4% OR >2% 5xx. Also abort on sustained GPU temp >88C.
PriyaR: + add: abort if warmstart failure rate increases >1% vs baseline.
deploybot: running preflight for qkernel-v4.2-quant on slice=eu-west-1-night. Validating signature and smoke tests.
opsbot: quiet window reminder 00:45-01:45 UTC. Approvals needed from eng-runtime leads + oncall.
MayaL: I'm oncall tonight, will take first responder. Diego can monitor metrics.
SamH: deploy plan: 1) push 10% canary 2) wait 5m warmstart 3) observe gating metrics 20m 4) roll forward tomorrow if green. rollback cmd: ```/deploy pin --project=runtime --version=qkernel-v4.1 --slice=eu-west-1-night```
deploybot: preflight passed. Canary ready.
DiegoR: launching canary -> 10% live. watching p99, warmstart, top10-diff, error-rate, gpu-temp.
DiegoR: 6m: p99 +1.5%, p50 -3%, warmstart stable, top10-diff 0.09%, no errors.
MayaL: seeing one host spiking p99 at i-0f1234, investigating.
DiegoR: draining that worker, p99 back to +0.5%. Note: driver on that host was older.
SamH: mark note "transient noisy host, drained". Keep canary running full window.
deploybot: canary at 10% for 15m elapsed. No gating violations.
MayaL: given clean signals, we will not advance tonight due to quiet window. Plan daytime 50% next. If repeat noisy hosts, we will pin to v4.1 and open follow-up for node-driver mismatch.
SamH: agreed. thanks team :thumbsup:
